question: Which is better, PlayStation or Xbox?
summary: PlayStation wins: the exclusives are still the reason to own a console, and Xbox now ships many of its own big games on PlayStation too.
winner_reason: Sony's first-party studios keep delivering system-sellers, and with Microsoft bringing many Xbox games to other platforms, a PlayStation now plays more of the year's big releases. Xbox is the better value pitch, not the better console to own.

dimensions.name: Exclusives
dimensions.a: God of War, Spider-Man, The Last of Us and Ghost of Tsushima give it a deep bench of must-play games.
dimensions.b: Halo, Forza and Gears are strong, but many Xbox-published games now also arrive on PlayStation.

dimensions.name: Value
dimensions.a: PlayStation Plus has tiers with a game catalogue, but day-one first-party releases are rare.
dimensions.b: Game Pass puts Microsoft's own games in the library on launch day, a genuinely great deal.

dimensions.name: Backward compatibility
dimensions.a: PS5 plays almost all PS4 games, but older generations are patchy.
dimensions.b: Xbox's backward compatibility program reaches back to many original Xbox and 360 games.

dimensions.name: Install base
dimensions.a: The PS5 has comfortably outsold the Xbox Series X|S this generation.
dimensions.b: Xbox trails in hardware sales and has shifted focus toward a multi-platform strategy.

dimensions.name: Controller
dimensions.a: The DualSense's haptics and adaptive triggers are a real step forward.
dimensions.b: The Xbox pad is a comfortable classic that also works seamlessly on PC.

pros_a: DualSense haptics add real feel to games
pros_b: Tight integration with Windows PC gaming

question: Is GTA 6 better than Red Dead Redemption 2?
summary: Red Dead Redemption 2 wins for now: it is a proven masterpiece, while GTA 6 is still unreleased. We will revisit this verdict after launch.
winner_reason: You cannot beat a game nobody has played yet. RDR2 is one of the most acclaimed open worlds ever made; GTA 6, scheduled for 19 November 2026, looks spectacular in trailers, and this verdict will be revisited once it is out.

dimensions.name: Track record
dimensions.a: Unreleased as of this verdict; scheduled for 19 November 2026 after an earlier delay.
dimensions.b: Released in 2018 to near-universal acclaim and still widely played.

dimensions.name: Story
dimensions.a: Two protagonists, Lucia and Jason, in a crime story Rockstar has only teased.
dimensions.b: Arthur Morgan's arc is often called one of the best-written stories in games.

dimensions.name: Setting
dimensions.a: Returns to Vice City in the fictional state of Leonida, a modern Florida satire.
dimensions.b: A beautifully detailed American frontier at the end of the outlaw era.

dimensions.name: Tech and scale
dimensions.a: Built for current-gen consoles from the start; trailers show striking density and detail.
dimensions.b: Still stunning, but designed around PS4 and Xbox One hardware.

dimensions.name: Pacing
dimensions.a: GTA games are traditionally fast, chaotic and playful.
dimensions.b: Deliberately slow and immersive, which some players find a slog.

pros_a: A fresh Vice City built for modern hardware
Two-protagonist crime story with Lucia and Jason
pros_b: Arthur Morgan's story is all-time great

question: Who is better, Batman or Superman?
summary: Batman wins: Superman would take a fair fight, but Batman has the better stories, the better villains and he never fights fair.
winner_reason: Superman is the stronger hero by miles, yet Batman is the more compelling character, with the deepest rogues gallery in comics and a run of classic stories and films few heroes can match. And with prep time and kryptonite, he has beaten Superman on the page.

dimensions.name: Raw power
dimensions.a: Peak human, no superpowers. Relies on training, gadgets and armour.
dimensions.b: Flight, heat vision, super strength and speed; one of DC's most powerful heroes.

dimensions.name: With prep time
dimensions.a: In The Dark Knight Returns he beats Superman with armour and kryptonite.
dimensions.b: Can be outplanned by someone who has studied his weaknesses.

dimensions.name: Rogues gallery
dimensions.a: Joker, Two-Face, Riddler, Catwoman, Penguin: arguably the best in comics.
dimensions.b: Lex Luthor is great, but the bench thins quickly after him.

dimensions.name: Best stories
dimensions.a: Year One, The Long Halloween, The Killing Joke and The Dark Knight Returns.
dimensions.b: All-Star Superman and Red Son are classics, with fewer of them.

dimensions.name: Symbolism
dimensions.a: A symbol of fear turned against crime.
dimensions.b: The original superhero and a lasting symbol of hope and decency.

pros_a: Wins with preparation, even against gods
A stack of genre-defining stories and films
pros_b: The template for every superhero since

question: Who would win, Wolverine or Deadpool?
summary: Wolverine wins: both can heal from almost anything, but adamantium claws and a century of combat experience give Logan the edge.
winner_reason: In Marvel comics canon both men are near-impossible to kill, so the fight comes down to tools and skill. Wolverine's adamantium skeleton and claws cut through Deadpool's swords and armour, and Logan is the more seasoned fighter.

dimensions.name: Healing factor
dimensions.a: Deadpool's healing factor is famously extreme, and he regenerates from terrible injuries.
dimensions.b: Wolverine's healing factor is the original and nearly as resilient.

dimensions.name: Weapons
dimensions.a: Katanas, guns and teleporting gadgets.
dimensions.b: Adamantium claws can cut almost anything, and his bones are unbreakable.

dimensions.name: Experience
dimensions.a: Highly trained mercenary with special forces background.
dimensions.b: Over a century of combat, from wars to the X-Men.

dimensions.name: Unpredictability
dimensions.a: Chaotic and fourth-wall aware, he is hard to read in a fight.
dimensions.b: A focused berserker who hits hard but is easier to bait.

dimensions.name: Popularity
dimensions.a: The Deadpool films made him a box-office star.
dimensions.b: Hugh Jackman's Logan is one of the most beloved superhero portrayals ever.

question: Who is better, Mario or Sonic?
summary: Mario wins: decades of consistently brilliant games beat Sonic's great 16-bit peak and a much bumpier 3D era.
winner_reason: Sonic gave Mario a real fight in the 90s, but Mario's run of classics from Super Mario Bros. to Odyssey and Bros. Wonder is unmatched in gaming. Sonic has had brilliant moments; Mario rarely misses.

dimensions.name: Consistency
dimensions.a: Mainline Mario games are almost always excellent.
dimensions.b: Highs like Sonic 2 and Sonic Mania, lows that fans still argue about.

dimensions.name: 16-bit era
dimensions.a: Super Mario World is a masterpiece.
dimensions.b: Sonic's Genesis games defined speed and attitude, and went toe to toe.

dimensions.name: 3D games
dimensions.a: Super Mario 64 and Galaxy helped define 3D platforming.
dimensions.b: Sonic's 3D games have been far more uneven, though Frontiers found fans.

dimensions.name: Style
dimensions.a: Cheerful, timeless and family-friendly.
dimensions.b: Cooler, faster and with a great soundtrack tradition.

dimensions.name: Movies
dimensions.a: The Super Mario Bros. Movie was a huge box-office hit.
dimensions.b: The Sonic films have been a pleasant success and a strong franchise.

pros_b: Speed and attitude no one else had
Sonic Mania shows the classic magic still works

question: Who would win, Goku or Superman?
summary: Superman wins: Goku is a better pure fighter, but top-tier DC comics Superman operates on a level of power even Ultra Instinct does not reach.
winner_reason: Judging the strongest versions in each canon (Dragon Ball Super for Goku, DC comics for Superman), Superman's feats are bigger, and he keeps getting stronger by absorbing sunlight. Goku would land plenty of hits, but he would run out of gas first.

dimensions.name: Canon used
dimensions.a: Dragon Ball Super anime and manga, including Ultra Instinct.
dimensions.b: DC comics, including high-end versions like All-Star Superman.

dimensions.name: Raw power
dimensions.a: Fights gods of destruction and can threaten planets and beyond.
dimensions.b: Top versions shrug off cosmic threats and perform universe-scale feats.

dimensions.name: Fighting skill
dimensions.a: A lifelong martial artist; technique is his whole identity.
dimensions.b: Mostly a brawler who relies on overwhelming strength and speed.

dimensions.name: Stamina
dimensions.a: Transformations drain him; long fights wear him down.
dimensions.b: Powered by the sun, he can recharge mid-fight.

dimensions.name: Weaknesses
dimensions.a: Overconfidence and a habit of letting enemies power up.
dimensions.b: Kryptonite and magic, neither of which Goku really has.

pros_a: The better martial artist by far
pros_b: Goku has no kryptonite or magic to exploit

question: Who is better, Iron Man or Captain America?
summary: Captain America wins: Iron Man has the firepower, but Cap is the Avengers' moral compass and won the Civil War fight that mattered.
winner_reason: Tony Stark is the more fun character and launched the MCU, but Steve Rogers is the better hero: steady, selfless and right when it counts. He ended Civil War standing, and he lifted Mjolnir.

dimensions.name: Firepower
dimensions.a: Super-soldier strength and a vibranium shield.
dimensions.b: Repulsors, missiles, flight and a suit for every situation.

dimensions.name: Leadership
dimensions.a: The natural leader the team follows into battle.
dimensions.b: A brilliant but impulsive teammate who often goes it alone.

dimensions.name: Head to head
dimensions.a: Disabled Tony's arc reactor to end their Civil War film fight.
dimensions.b: Had the tech edge but lost that fight.

dimensions.name: Character arc
dimensions.a: From man out of time to a well-earned retirement.
dimensions.b: From selfish arms dealer to the ultimate sacrifice in Endgame.

dimensions.name: Integrity
dimensions.a: Worthy of Mjolnir. Enough said.
dimensions.b: Good intentions, but also built Ultron.

question: Who would win, Superman or Thor?
summary: Thor wins, narrowly: Superman is faster and arguably stronger, but magic is one of his weaknesses and Mjolnir is pure magic.
winner_reason: In comics canon these two are close; the official JLA/Avengers crossover never settled it cleanly. The tiebreaker is magic: Thor's lightning and enchanted hammer cut through the defences that make Superman so hard to hurt.

dimensions.name: Canon used
dimensions.a: DC comics, mainstream versions.
dimensions.b: Marvel comics, mainstream versions.

dimensions.name: Strength
dimensions.a: Among the strongest beings in DC, especially when charged by the sun.
dimensions.b: A god of immense strength, boosted further by Mjolnir.

dimensions.name: Speed
dimensions.a: Faster than Thor in most portrayals.
dimensions.b: Fast in flight, but not at Superman's level.

dimensions.name: Magic matchup
dimensions.a: Vulnerable to magic, which bypasses his invulnerability.
dimensions.b: His powers and hammer are magical by nature.

dimensions.name: Weapons
dimensions.a: Fights with fists, heat vision and freeze breath.
dimensions.b: Mjolnir delivers lightning and returns to his hand.

pros_a: Heat vision and freeze breath add range

question: Who would win, Hulk or Thor?
summary: Thor wins: Hulk might be the stronger brawler, but Thor has flight, lightning, a magic hammer and a warrior's head.
winner_reason: In Marvel comics their fights have swung both ways for decades, but Thor brings more tools: range, flight, lightning and battle experience measured in centuries. Hulk needs a long, angry slugfest to win, and Thor rarely has to give him one.

dimensions.name: Canon used
dimensions.a: Marvel comics (Earth-616), with the MCU as a footnote.
dimensions.b: Marvel comics (Earth-616), with the MCU as a footnote.

dimensions.name: Raw strength
dimensions.a: The madder he gets, the stronger he gets, in theory without limit.
dimensions.b: Enormously strong, but rarely out-muscles a fully enraged Hulk.

dimensions.name: Versatility
dimensions.a: Punches, leaps and thunderclaps.
dimensions.b: Flight, lightning, weather control and a returning hammer.

dimensions.name: Experience
dimensions.a: Fights on instinct and rage.
dimensions.b: A trained warrior with centuries of battles behind him.

dimensions.name: MCU fight
dimensions.a: In Ragnarok, held his own in the arena.
dimensions.b: Was gaining the upper hand with lightning before the Grandmaster stopped it.

pros_a: Strength that keeps scaling with rage

question: Who is better, Drake or Kendrick Lamar?
summary: Kendrick Lamar wins: Drake has more hits, but Kendrick has the better albums and won their 2024 beat with Not Like Us.
winner_reason: Drake is one of the most commercially successful artists ever, but Kendrick's albums are the ones critics and fans treat as classics. The 2024 beef settled it publicly: Not Like Us became a cultural event, won Grammys for Record and Song of the Year, and led into his Super Bowl halftime show.

dimensions.name: Hits
dimensions.a: A near-endless run of chart hits and streaming records.
dimensions.b: Plenty of hits, but fewer and less frequent.

dimensions.name: Albums
dimensions.a: Take Care is a classic; much of the rest is long and uneven.
dimensions.b: good kid, m.A.A.d city, To Pimp a Butterfly and DAMN. are landmark records.

dimensions.name: Lyricism
dimensions.a: Sharp, quotable and melodic, but rarely dense.
dimensions.b: Layered storytelling and technique; won a Pulitzer Prize for DAMN.

dimensions.name: The beef
dimensions.a: Fired back with several diss tracks, but none landed like Kendrick's.
dimensions.b: Not Like Us became an anthem and the defining moment of 2024 rap.

dimensions.name: Versatility
dimensions.a: Moves easily between rap, R&B and pop.
dimensions.b: Experimental and jazz-influenced, but less of a pop chameleon.

pros_a: One of the biggest hitmakers of the streaming era
Blends rap, R&B and pop effortlessly
pros_b: A run of classic, acclaimed albums
Won the most famous rap beef in years

question: Who is better, Michael Jackson or Prince?
summary: Michael Jackson wins: Prince was the greater musician, but Michael was the bigger star, the better dancer and changed pop worldwide.
winner_reason: Prince could write, produce and play nearly everything himself, and that matters. But Thriller is widely cited as the best-selling album of all time, Michael's videos and dancing reshaped pop, and his global reach has no equal.

dimensions.name: Musicianship
dimensions.a: A gifted singer and arranger who worked with top producers like Quincy Jones.
dimensions.b: Multi-instrumentalist virtuoso who often played every part himself.

dimensions.name: Performance
dimensions.a: The moonwalk and some of the most imitated dance moves ever.
dimensions.b: A thrilling live performer and guitar hero.

dimensions.name: Commercial impact
dimensions.a: Thriller is widely cited as the best-selling album ever.
dimensions.b: Huge sales, led by Purple Rain, but not at Michael's scale.

dimensions.name: Songwriting
dimensions.a: Wrote classics like Billie Jean and Beat It.
dimensions.b: Prolific; wrote hits for himself and others, like Nothing Compares 2 U.

dimensions.name: Cultural reach
dimensions.a: Music videos as events; a global icon.
dimensions.b: Hugely influential, especially among musicians.

pros_a: The biggest pop star the world has seen
pros_b: Wrote, produced and played it all

question: Who would win, Gandalf or Dumbledore?
summary: Gandalf wins: Dumbledore is the greatest wizard of his age, but Gandalf is an angelic being who died fighting a Balrog and came back.
winner_reason: Tolkien's wizards are Maiar, immortal spirits in human form, so Gandalf is a different order of being from any Hogwarts headmaster. Dumbledore's spell arsenal is flashier, but Gandalf beat a Balrog and returned from death stronger.

dimensions.name: Nature
dimensions.a: A human wizard, extraordinarily gifted but mortal.
dimensions.b: A Maia, an immortal spirit sent to Middle-earth.

dimensions.name: Spellcraft
dimensions.a: Huge range of spells; out-duelled Voldemort at the Ministry.
dimensions.b: Magic is subtle and rarely shown on the page.

dimensions.name: Biggest feat
dimensions.a: Defeated Grindelwald in a legendary duel.
dimensions.b: Slew the Balrog of Moria and returned as Gandalf the White.

dimensions.name: Wisdom
dimensions.a: Brilliant, but secretive and manipulative at times.
dimensions.b: Patient, kind and rarely wrong about people.

dimensions.name: Mentorship
dimensions.a: Shaped Harry's whole journey, for better and worse.
dimensions.b: Guided Bilbo, Frodo and Aragorn toward their destinies.

question: Who is better, Batman or Spider-Man?
summary: Batman wins, just: Spider-Man is the more relatable hero, but Batman has darker stakes, sharper stories and the edge in a fight.
winner_reason: Both are top-tier characters with great villains. Batman edges it with a deeper bench of classic stories and his detective skills, and with prep he can neutralise Spider-Man's speed and strength.

dimensions.name: Powers
dimensions.a: No powers; relies on gadgets, training and intellect.
dimensions.b: Super strength, agility, wall-crawling and spider-sense.

dimensions.name: Intelligence
dimensions.a: The World's Greatest Detective and a master strategist.
dimensions.b: A genius scientist who built his own web-shooters.

dimensions.name: Relatability
dimensions.a: A billionaire with a tragic past.
dimensions.b: An ordinary kid juggling rent, school and saving the city.

dimensions.name: Villains
dimensions.a: Joker, Riddler and Two-Face are all iconic.
dimensions.b: Green Goblin, Doc Ock and Venom are close behind.

dimensions.name: Best stories
dimensions.a: Year One, The Long Halloween and The Dark Knight.
dimensions.b: Spider-Verse films and classic Lee and Ditko comics.

pros_b: Into the Spider-Verse is all-time great

question: Which is better, Pokémon or Digimon?
summary: Pokémon wins: Digimon had the better early anime story, but Pokémon has the games, the designs and the staying power.
winner_reason: Pokémon is the highest-grossing media franchise in the world thanks to a core game series that never stopped. Digimon Adventure told a more emotional story, yet as a whole franchise it never matched Pokémon's reach or consistency.

dimensions.name: Games
dimensions.a: Cult favourites like Digimon Story, but no consistent mainline.
dimensions.b: A huge mainline RPG series that keeps selling in the millions.

dimensions.name: Anime
dimensions.a: Digimon Adventure had real stakes, growth and emotion.
dimensions.b: Long-running and charming, but famously episodic.

dimensions.name: Designs
dimensions.a: Cool evolutions, but many forms are hard to tell apart.
dimensions.b: Simple, iconic designs from Pikachu to Charizard.

dimensions.name: Cultural impact
dimensions.a: A beloved 90s and 2000s phenomenon.
dimensions.b: A global brand across games, cards, toys and Pokémon Go.

dimensions.name: Evolution
dimensions.a: Digivolution is dramatic and often temporary, great for battles.
dimensions.b: Permanent evolution feels like real growth for your team.

pros_a: Digimon talk and have real personalities

question: Is Breaking Bad better than Better Call Saul?
search_query: breaking bad vs better call saul
summary: Breaking Bad wins: it is the faster, bolder thrill ride, even if Better Call Saul might be the more finely crafted show.
winner_reason: Breaking Bad set the standard for a slow-burn transformation told at thriller pace, and its final season is close to perfect. Better Call Saul is a masterclass in patience and craft, but it needs the original's foundation to fully land.

dimensions.name: Pacing
dimensions.a: Deliberate and slow-building; some early stretches test patience.
dimensions.b: Relentless tension that builds to a breathless final season.

dimensions.name: Craft
dimensions.a: Gorgeous cinematography and meticulous character work.
dimensions.b: Excellent, but slightly less refined shot for shot.

dimensions.name: Lead character
dimensions.a: Jimmy McGill's fall is heartbreaking and human.
dimensions.b: Walter White's turn from teacher to kingpin is iconic.

dimensions.name: Supporting cast
dimensions.a: Kim Wexler is one of TV's best characters.
dimensions.b: Jesse, Hank, Gus and Mike are all unforgettable.

dimensions.name: Ending
dimensions.a: A quiet, moving finale that rewards long-time viewers.
dimensions.b: Felina wraps everything up with rare precision.

pros_b: Thriller pacing that never lets up

question: Which is better, Pixar or DreamWorks?
summary: Pixar wins: DreamWorks makes some great films, but Pixar's peak run of Toy Story, Up and Inside Out is the gold standard of animation.
winner_reason: Pixar pioneered feature-length computer animation and built a run of emotionally rich films that defined a generation. DreamWorks has real gems and has been on a strong streak lately, but its catalogue is more uneven.

dimensions.name: Peak films
dimensions.a: Shrek, Kung Fu Panda and How to Train Your Dragon.
dimensions.b: Toy Story, WALL-E, Up, Inside Out and Coco.

dimensions.name: Emotional depth
dimensions.a: Can hit hard, especially in How to Train Your Dragon.
dimensions.b: Famous for making adults cry in the first ten minutes.

dimensions.name: Humour
dimensions.a: Sharper, more irreverent comedy, from Shrek onward.
dimensions.b: Gentle and clever, but less cheeky.

dimensions.name: Consistency
dimensions.a: More misses mixed in with the hits.
dimensions.b: A remarkable early hit rate, with some recent dips.

dimensions.name: Innovation
dimensions.a: Bold stylistic swings like The Bad Guys and Puss in Boots: The Last Wish.
dimensions.b: Made Toy Story, the first fully computer-animated feature.

pros_a: How to Train Your Dragon is a classic
Recent films have taken real style risks
pros_b: The best run in animation history

question: Which is better, League of Legends or Dota 2?
summary: League of Legends wins: Dota 2 is the deeper game, but League is easier to get into, has more players and has the bigger esports stage.
winner_reason: For most players League is the better choice: shorter learning curve, faster games and a far larger community and esports scene, with Arcane bringing in people who had never played. Dota 2 rewards mastery more, but asks a lot more first.

dimensions.name: Depth
dimensions.a: Enormously complex, with denies, couriers and huge item interactions.
dimensions.b: Deep, but streamlined and more forgiving.

dimensions.name: Accessibility
dimensions.a: A notoriously steep learning curve.
dimensions.b: Easier for new players to pick up and enjoy.

dimensions.name: Monetisation
dimensions.a: Every hero is free from day one.
dimensions.b: Champions must be unlocked, though that is easy with play.

dimensions.name: Player base
dimensions.a: Large and loyal, but smaller.
dimensions.b: One of the most played PC games in the world.

dimensions.name: Esports
dimensions.a: The International was famous for crowdfunded prize pools.
dimensions.b: Worlds is among the most watched events in all of esports.

dimensions.name: Wider universe
dimensions.a: Some lore and an animated series.
dimensions.b: Arcane is one of the best video game adaptations ever.

question: Who would win, Iron Man or Batman?
summary: Iron Man wins: both are rich geniuses, but only one has a flying suit with repulsors, missiles and an AI co-pilot.
winner_reason: In a straight fight, the tech gap is too wide. Batman's prep and fighting skill are elite, but Iron Man's armour flies, absorbs heavy damage and hits from range, so Batman would need a perfect plan just to stay in it.

dimensions.name: Tech
dimensions.a: Superb gadgets, a Batsuit and the Batmobile.
dimensions.b: Powered armour with flight, repulsors and missiles.

dimensions.name: Hand to hand
dimensions.a: A master of dozens of martial arts.
dimensions.b: Competent, but leans on the suit.

dimensions.name: Intellect
dimensions.a: The World's Greatest Detective.
dimensions.b: A genius engineer and inventor.

dimensions.name: Preparation
dimensions.a: Famous for contingency plans for every scenario.
dimensions.b: Improvises brilliantly and builds on the fly.

dimensions.name: Wealth
dimensions.a: A billionaire with Wayne Enterprises behind him.
dimensions.b: A billionaire with Stark Industries behind him.

pros_b: Armour that shrugs off Batman's gadgets
An AI that helps him adapt mid-fight

question: Who is better, Elvis or Michael Jackson?
summary: Michael Jackson wins: Elvis is the King of Rock and Roll, but Michael took pop global with better songs, dancing and videos.
winner_reason: Elvis broke open rock and roll for mainstream America and that legacy is permanent. Michael went further: he wrote many of his own hits, redefined live performance and music videos, and made pop a worldwide event.

dimensions.name: Pioneering
dimensions.a: Brought rock and roll to the mainstream in the 1950s.
dimensions.b: Built on soul, funk and Motown traditions.

dimensions.name: Songwriting
dimensions.a: Mostly sang songs written by others.
dimensions.b: Wrote classics like Billie Jean and Beat It.

dimensions.name: Performance
dimensions.a: Hips and charisma that shocked 1950s TV audiences.
dimensions.b: The moonwalk and some of the most copied dance moves ever.

dimensions.name: Global reach
dimensions.a: Huge in America and beyond.
dimensions.b: A truly worldwide superstar.

dimensions.name: Voice
dimensions.a: A rich baritone with a remarkable range of styles.
dimensions.b: An agile, emotive voice from childhood onward.

pros_a: The King of Rock and Roll
pros_b: Wrote many of his biggest hits

question: Who is better, Tupac or Biggie?
summary: Biggie wins on the mic: Tupac is the bigger legend, but Biggie's flow, storytelling and two classic albums make him the better rapper.
winner_reason: As pure rappers, Biggie's effortless flow, wordplay and storytelling are hard to top, and Ready to Die and Life After Death are near-flawless. Tupac had more passion, range and cultural weight, but the question is who rapped better.

dimensions.name: Flow
dimensions.a: Smooth, effortless and endlessly imitated.
dimensions.b: Forceful and emotional, but less technically varied.

dimensions.name: Storytelling
dimensions.a: Vivid, cinematic street narratives like Warning.
dimensions.b: Moving, personal stories like Dear Mama and Brenda's Got a Baby.

dimensions.name: Discography
dimensions.a: Two classic albums, tight and consistent.
dimensions.b: More albums, including All Eyez on Me, with more filler.

dimensions.name: Message
dimensions.a: More focused on hustle and street life.
dimensions.b: Spoke on social issues with real passion.

dimensions.name: Legacy
dimensions.a: Revered as one of the greatest rappers ever.
dimensions.b: A global icon whose image goes beyond music.

pros_a: Arguably the best flow in hip-hop

question: Which is better, Naruto or One Piece?
summary: One Piece wins: Naruto has great fights and a moving first half, but One Piece's worldbuilding and long-planned mysteries are in a league of their own.
winner_reason: Eiichiro Oda has built the most ambitious world in manga, with setups that pay off hundreds of chapters later. Naruto has some of shonen's best rivalries and emotion, but its later arcs lose focus in a way One Piece mostly avoids.

dimensions.name: Worldbuilding
dimensions.a: A memorable ninja world with clans and villages.
dimensions.b: A vast, detailed world full of islands, cultures and history.

dimensions.name: Fights
dimensions.a: Fast, tactical ninja fights, especially in the early arcs.
dimensions.b: Big and creative, but sometimes long-winded.

dimensions.name: Main character
dimensions.a: Naruto's journey from outcast to Hokage is deeply moving.
dimensions.b: Luffy is pure joy, but less inward and complex.

dimensions.name: Cast
dimensions.a: Strong core cast, with many sidelined later.
dimensions.b: The Straw Hats each get rich backstories.

dimensions.name: Accessibility
dimensions.a: A finished story you can actually complete.
dimensions.b: A huge episode count can scare off newcomers.

pros_a: Iconic rivalry between Naruto and Sasuke
A complete story with an ending
pros_b: Setups that pay off years later
The Straw Hats are a perfect crew

question: Who is better, The Beatles or The Rolling Stones?
summary: The Beatles win: the Stones are the greater rock and roll band, but the Beatles packed more invention into eight years than most bands manage in a lifetime.
winner_reason: The Beatles reinvented pop music album by album, from Rubber Soul to Abbey Road, and their songwriting remains the template. The Rolling Stones rocked harder and lasted far longer, but their influence on what music could be is smaller.

dimensions.name: Songwriting
dimensions.a: Lennon-McCartney, plus Harrison, wrote a huge share of pop's standards.
dimensions.b: Jagger-Richards wrote classic riffs and swagger-filled anthems.

dimensions.name: Innovation
dimensions.a: Pioneered studio techniques on Revolver and Sgt. Pepper.
dimensions.b: Brilliant, but more rooted in blues and rock tradition.

dimensions.name: Live shows
dimensions.a: Stopped touring in 1966.
dimensions.b: One of the greatest live bands, touring for decades.

dimensions.name: Longevity
dimensions.a: Split in 1970 after a short, intense career.
dimensions.b: Still recording and performing many decades on.

dimensions.name: Influence
dimensions.a: Arguably the most influential band in pop history.
dimensions.b: Defined the rock-band image for generations.

question: Is The Simpsons better than Family Guy?
summary: The Simpsons wins: its classic seasons are among the best TV comedy ever made, and Family Guy would not exist without it.
winner_reason: At its peak in the 1990s The Simpsons combined jokes, heart and satire better than any sitcom, animated or not. Family Guy's cutaway chaos can be very funny, but it rarely matches The Simpsons' writing or warmth.

dimensions.name: Peak quality
dimensions.a: Some strong seasons, but no golden age to rival the 90s Simpsons.
dimensions.b: Seasons 3 to 8 or so are often called the best sitcom run ever.

dimensions.name: Humour style
dimensions.a: Cutaway gags, shock humour and absurdism.
dimensions.b: Character-driven jokes with layers of satire.

dimensions.name: Heart
dimensions.a: Occasional sweet moments, mostly played for laughs.
dimensions.b: Episodes like Lisa's Substitute genuinely move people.

dimensions.name: Edginess
dimensions.a: Pushes boundaries harder and more often.
dimensions.b: Gentler and more family-friendly.

dimensions.name: Legacy
dimensions.a: Shaped a generation of cutaway-style comedy.
dimensions.b: The longest-running American scripted primetime series.

pros_a: Stewie and Brian are great creations
Fast, random gags that hit hard
pros_b: The greatest golden age in TV comedy

question: Is Lord of the Rings better than Harry Potter?
search_query: harry potter vs lord of the rings
summary: Lord of the Rings wins: Harry Potter is the more fun read, but Tolkien built modern fantasy, and Peter Jackson's trilogy is the better film saga.
winner_reason: Tolkien created languages, histories and a mythology that nearly every fantasy since has borrowed from. Harry Potter brought millions of kids to reading, which matters, but as literature and film, Middle-earth stands taller.

dimensions.name: Worldbuilding
dimensions.a: Charming wizarding world, but the rules can be loose.
dimensions.b: Languages, maps and thousands of years of history.

dimensions.name: Readability
dimensions.a: Fast, funny and easy to love at any age.
dimensions.b: Slower, dense and sometimes daunting.

dimensions.name: Films
dimensions.a: Eight solid films that grew up with their cast.
dimensions.b: A trilogy that ended with Return of the King's Best Picture Oscar.

dimensions.name: Influence
dimensions.a: Got a generation reading and launched a YA boom.
dimensions.b: The foundation of modern fantasy.

dimensions.name: Characters
dimensions.a: Harry, Hermione, Ron and Snape are beloved.
dimensions.b: Frodo, Sam, Gandalf and Aragorn are archetypes.

question: Is Battlefield better than Call of Duty?
summary: Battlefield wins: Call of Duty is slicker and more consistent, but nothing beats a big Battlefield match with tanks, jets and buildings coming down.
winner_reason: Battlefield offers something no other shooter does as well: large-scale combined-arms warfare with vehicles, destruction and squad play. Call of Duty is the more polished and dependable series, but Battlefield at its best delivers the more memorable moments.

dimensions.name: Scale
dimensions.a: Huge maps, many players, land, sea and air vehicles.
dimensions.b: Tighter maps and fast, smaller-scale fights.

dimensions.name: Gunplay
dimensions.a: Weighty and satisfying, but less snappy.
dimensions.b: Arguably the smoothest gunfeel in the genre.

dimensions.name: Consistency
dimensions.a: Some rocky launches, like Battlefield 2042.
dimensions.b: A reliable yearly release with steady quality.

dimensions.name: Destruction
dimensions.a: Destructible environments change how battles play out.
dimensions.b: Mostly static maps.

dimensions.name: Campaigns
dimensions.a: Often an afterthought.
dimensions.b: Modern Warfare-style campaigns are blockbuster set pieces.

dimensions.name: Teamplay
dimensions.a: Classes and squads make teamwork matter.
dimensions.b: More about individual skill and killstreaks.

question: Who is better, Mickey Mouse or Bugs Bunny?
summary: Bugs Bunny wins: Mickey is the bigger brand, but Bugs is the funnier, sharper character with the better cartoons.
winner_reason: Mickey is a corporate icon whose personality has been smoothed into a logo. Bugs, with his cool wit and endless comebacks, starred in Looney Tunes shorts like What's Opera, Doc? that are still among the funniest cartoons ever made.

dimensions.name: Comedy
dimensions.a: Quick, sarcastic and always in control.
dimensions.b: Cheerful and likeable, rarely the funniest in the room.

dimensions.name: Cartoons
dimensions.a: Classic Looney Tunes shorts by Chuck Jones and others.
dimensions.b: Early shorts like Steamboat Willie were landmarks.

dimensions.name: Brand power
dimensions.a: A Warner Bros. icon.
dimensions.b: The face of Disney and its theme parks worldwide.

dimensions.name: History
dimensions.a: Debuted in 1940's A Wild Hare.
dimensions.b: Debuted in 1928; helped make synchronised sound cartoons a hit.

dimensions.name: Personality
dimensions.a: A trickster with a catchphrase everyone knows.
dimensions.b: Friendly, but mostly a mascot now.

pros_a: Some of the best cartoons ever
pros_b: The world's most famous cartoon icon
Face of a global entertainment empire

question: Which is better, The Sopranos or The Wire?
summary: The Sopranos wins: The Wire is the greater portrait of a city, but Tony Soprano is TV's richest character and the show launched the golden age.
winner_reason: The Sopranos changed what TV could be, with a complex antihero, dream sequences and dark comedy. The Wire is a brilliant, sprawling study of institutions, but The Sopranos is the deeper character study and the more influential show.

dimensions.name: Lead character
dimensions.a: Tony Soprano is one of the most complex characters on TV.
dimensions.b: An ensemble show without a single central lead.

dimensions.name: Scope
dimensions.a: One family and one crew, explored in depth.
dimensions.b: Drugs, docks, politics, schools and the press across Baltimore.

dimensions.name: Influence
dimensions.a: Kicked off the prestige TV era.
dimensions.b: Hugely respected, but slower to find an audience.

dimensions.name: Realism
dimensions.a: Grounded, with dreamlike flourishes.
dimensions.b: Close to documentary in its realism.

dimensions.name: Humour
dimensions.a: Darkly funny throughout.
dimensions.b: Dry wit, but more serious overall.

pros_a: Tony Soprano is an all-time great
Started the golden age of TV
pros_b: Every season tackles a new institution

question: Who would win, Spider-Man or Deadpool?
summary: Spider-Man wins: Deadpool cannot stay dead, but spider-sense, superior strength and speed mean he rarely lands a clean hit.
winner_reason: In Marvel comics canon, Spider-Man's spider-sense lets him dodge nearly everything Deadpool throws, and he is far stronger. Deadpool's healing means he can keep coming, but Spidey can web him up and walk away.

dimensions.name: Strength
dimensions.a: Peak-human strength enhanced by his healing factor.
dimensions.b: Can lift many tons, far beyond Deadpool.

dimensions.name: Durability
dimensions.a: Heals from almost anything, even severe injuries.
dimensions.b: Tough, but no healing factor to match.

dimensions.name: Spider-sense
dimensions.a: Can't easily get the jump on him.
dimensions.b: Warns him of danger and helps him dodge.

dimensions.name: Weapons
dimensions.a: Swords, guns and gadgets.
dimensions.b: Webs can bind and neutralise him without lethal force.

dimensions.name: Banter
dimensions.a: Fourth-wall-breaking motormouth.
dimensions.b: Witty, but outmatched in pure chatter.

question: Is The Office better than Parks and Recreation?
search_query: the office vs parks and rec
summary: The Office wins: Parks and Rec is warmer and more consistent, but The Office's best seasons are funnier and far more rewatched.
winner_reason: The Office at its peak, from season 2 to season 4 or so, is a comedy masterclass, and its cringe humour created icons like Michael Scott and Dwight. Parks and Rec is more consistent and kinder, but The Office set the template.

dimensions.name: Peak seasons
dimensions.a: Seasons 3 to 5 are excellent.
dimensions.b: Seasons 2 to 4 are some of the best sitcom TV ever.

dimensions.name: Consistency
dimensions.a: A shaky first season, then strong to the end.
dimensions.b: Noticeable dip after Steve Carell left.

dimensions.name: Cast
dimensions.a: Leslie, Ron, April and Andy are all gold.
dimensions.b: Michael, Dwight, Jim and Pam are icons.

dimensions.name: Tone
dimensions.a: Optimistic, warm and kind.
dimensions.b: Cringe humour balanced with heart.

dimensions.name: Rewatchability
dimensions.a: Very rewatchable comfort TV.
dimensions.b: One of the most rewatched streaming shows ever.

question: Is Breaking Bad better than The Sopranos?
summary: The Sopranos wins, by a whisker: Breaking Bad is the tighter thriller, but The Sopranos is the richer, more influential show.
winner_reason: Breaking Bad has the stronger plot momentum and a cleaner ending. The Sopranos goes deeper, into therapy, family and the American dream, and every antihero drama since, Breaking Bad included, walks the path it cleared.

dimensions.name: Plot
dimensions.a: Tight, escalating and addictive.
dimensions.b: Meandering at times, by design.

dimensions.name: Depth
dimensions.a: A powerful study of pride and ego.
dimensions.b: Explores therapy, family, class and identity in layers.

dimensions.name: Lead
dimensions.a: Walter White's transformation is iconic.
dimensions.b: Tony Soprano is complex, funny and frightening.

dimensions.name: Ending
dimensions.a: Felina gives a satisfying, clean finish.
dimensions.b: The cut to black is still debated.

dimensions.name: Influence
dimensions.a: Took the antihero formula to new heights.
dimensions.b: Created the modern prestige drama.

pros_b: Tony Soprano is TV's richest character

question: Which is better, One Piece or Dragon Ball?
summary: One Piece wins: Dragon Ball wrote the shonen rulebook, but One Piece tells a richer story with a deeper cast.
winner_reason: Dragon Ball is the foundation of modern shonen and its fights are legendary. One Piece builds on that with a sprawling world, emotional character arcs and mysteries planned over decades, making it the better story overall.

dimensions.name: Influence
dimensions.a: Inspired Naruto, One Piece and a generation of manga.
dimensions.b: Hugely influential, but built on Dragon Ball's template.

dimensions.name: Story
dimensions.a: Simple: get stronger, beat the next villain.
dimensions.b: A layered adventure with politics, history and mystery.

dimensions.name: Fights
dimensions.a: Iconic battles and transformations.
dimensions.b: Inventive, but slower paced.

dimensions.name: Characters
dimensions.a: Goku and Vegeta are legends; side cast is underused.
dimensions.b: The Straw Hats each get rich, emotional arcs.

dimensions.name: Worldbuilding
dimensions.a: Fun, but loosely defined.
dimensions.b: One of the most detailed worlds in fiction.

question: Is South Park better than Family Guy?
summary: South Park wins: Family Guy is great for random gags, but South Park's sharp satire and fast turnaround make it the smarter show.
winner_reason: South Park's tight production schedule lets it react to the news with pointed satire, and its best episodes have real story structure. Family Guy is funny in bursts, but its humour is looser and more repetitive.

dimensions.name: Satire
dimensions.a: Pop-culture jokes over sharp commentary.
dimensions.b: Some of TV's sharpest, most topical satire.

dimensions.name: Story
dimensions.a: Plots often serve the cutaways.
dimensions.b: Episodes are tightly plotted and often surprise.

dimensions.name: Animation
dimensions.a: Polished, traditional TV animation.
dimensions.b: Deliberately crude cut-paper style.

dimensions.name: Gags
dimensions.a: Cutaways and musical numbers are its strength.
dimensions.b: Fewer gags, more situational comedy.

dimensions.name: Relevance
dimensions.a: Feels the same from year to year.
dimensions.b: Stays fresh by reacting to current events.

question: Is Seinfeld better than Friends?
summary: Seinfeld wins: Friends is cosier and easier to love, but Seinfeld's writing is sharper and changed sitcoms for good.
winner_reason: Seinfeld's interlocking plots, catchphrases and famous no hugging, no learning attitude made it one of the most influential sitcoms ever. Friends is warmer and more rewatchable for many, but Seinfeld is the better-written comedy.

dimensions.name: Writing
dimensions.a: Solid jokes and romantic storylines.
dimensions.b: Ingenious plots that tie together in the final scenes.

dimensions.name: Warmth
dimensions.a: Six friends you want to hang out with.
dimensions.b: Four deliberately selfish people.

dimensions.name: Influence
dimensions.a: Shaped hangout sitcoms and 90s fashion.
dimensions.b: Redefined sitcom structure and comedy.

dimensions.name: Catchphrases
dimensions.a: How you doin' and We were on a break.
dimensions.b: Yada yada, No soup for you, Serenity now.

dimensions.name: Rewatchability
dimensions.a: A huge comfort-watch for generations.
dimensions.b: Highly rewatchable, but more of an acquired taste.

question: Is Fortnite better than Roblox?
summary: Fortnite wins as a game: Roblox has more variety, but Fortnite is far more polished and its core modes are simply better made.
winner_reason: Fortnite's battle royale, building and constant live events show what a big studio can do, and its creative mode now offers player-made games too. Roblox wins on sheer variety and creativity, but quality is hit or miss.

dimensions.name: Polish
dimensions.a: High production values from Epic Games.
dimensions.b: Varies wildly from game to game.

dimensions.name: Variety
dimensions.a: Battle royale, creative maps and more.
dimensions.b: Millions of player-made experiences.

dimensions.name: Creativity
dimensions.a: Creative mode and UEFN let players build.
dimensions.b: Built entirely around user creation.

dimensions.name: Events
dimensions.a: Concerts and live events are cultural moments.
dimensions.b: Events exist, but are less of a spectacle.

dimensions.name: Competitive
dimensions.a: A big esports scene and skill-based play.
dimensions.b: Mostly casual.

pros_b: Teaches kids to create and code

question: Who is better, Taylor Swift or Beyoncé?
summary: It's a tie: Beyoncé is the greater performer and vocalist, Taylor Swift the greater songwriter and commercial force. Both are all-time greats.
winner_reason: They excel at different things. Beyoncé holds the record for most Grammy wins and is pop's best live performer; Swift has four Album of the Year Grammys and ran the Eras Tour, the highest-grossing tour ever. Picking one says more about taste than greatness.

dimensions.name: Vocals
dimensions.a: Powerful, versatile and technically superb.
dimensions.b: Expressive, but not in Beyoncé's league as a singer.

dimensions.name: Songwriting
dimensions.a: A co-writer with strong creative vision.
dimensions.b: Writes or co-writes all her songs; a storytelling master.

dimensions.name: Performance
dimensions.a: Arguably the best live performer of her generation.
dimensions.b: Eras Tour shows were marathon spectacles.

dimensions.name: Commercial
dimensions.a: Huge sales and sold-out stadium tours.
dimensions.b: The Eras Tour became the highest-grossing tour ever.

dimensions.name: Awards
dimensions.a: Most Grammy wins of any artist.
dimensions.b: Record four Album of the Year wins.

pros_a: Best live performer of her era
pros_b: Four Album of the Year Grammys

question: Is Dune better than Star Wars?
summary: Dune wins: Star Wars is the bigger and more fun saga, but Dune is the deeper story, and Star Wars borrowed plenty from it.
winner_reason: Frank Herbert's novel tackles religion, ecology and power with a complexity Star Wars never attempts, and Denis Villeneuve's films finally did it justice on screen. Star Wars wins on joy and cultural reach, not depth.

dimensions.name: Depth
dimensions.a: Explores religion, politics, ecology and the danger of heroes.
dimensions.b: A classic hero's journey of good against evil.

dimensions.name: Fun
dimensions.a: Grand and serious, sometimes heavy.
dimensions.b: Lightsabers, space battles and pure adventure.

dimensions.name: Worldbuilding
dimensions.a: Arrakis, the spice and the great houses are richly detailed.
dimensions.b: A vast galaxy, though often thinly sketched.

dimensions.name: Films
dimensions.a: Villeneuve's films are acclaimed and visually stunning.
dimensions.b: The original trilogy is iconic; later films are mixed.

dimensions.name: Cultural impact
dimensions.a: Hugely influential in science fiction.
dimensions.b: One of the biggest pop-culture franchises ever.

question: Who is the better villain, Darth Vader or Voldemort?
summary: Darth Vader wins: Voldemort is pure menace, but Vader has the look, the voice, the twist and a redemption arc that gives him real depth.
winner_reason: Vader is often named the greatest movie villain ever, with an iconic design, unforgettable music and the most famous twist in cinema. Voldemort is frightening, but he never changes; Vader's fall and redemption make him tragic.

dimensions.name: Presence
dimensions.a: Black armour, breathing and the Imperial March.
dimensions.b: Snake-like and eerie, most chilling in the books.

dimensions.name: Depth
dimensions.a: A fallen hero whose redemption drives the saga.
dimensions.b: A fully evil villain with a tragic backstory.

dimensions.name: Power
dimensions.a: A Force powerhouse and master duelist.
dimensions.b: The most feared dark wizard of his age.

dimensions.name: Iconic moment
dimensions.a: I am your father.
dimensions.b: His return in the graveyard in Goblet of Fire.

dimensions.name: Fear factor
dimensions.a: Intimidating, but sometimes restrained.
dimensions.b: Kills without hesitation; children fear his name.

pros_a: The most iconic villain design ever
pros_b: Fear so strong people won't say his name

question: Which is better, the Star Wars prequels or the sequels?
summary: The prequels win: clunky dialogue and all, they tell one story with a plan, while the sequels contradict themselves across three films.
winner_reason: George Lucas's prequels have a clear arc, Anakin's fall, ending with the powerful Revenge of the Sith. The sequels have better acting and effects, but they changed direction from film to film, and the story never fully hangs together.

dimensions.name: Story
dimensions.a: A coherent arc of Anakin's fall to the dark side.
dimensions.b: Shifting plans across directors; The Rise of Skywalker split fans.

dimensions.name: Acting
dimensions.a: Stiff dialogue undermines strong actors at times.
dimensions.b: Strong performances from Adam Driver, Daisy Ridley and others.

dimensions.name: Lightsaber duels
dimensions.a: Duel of the Fates and Mustafar are classics.
dimensions.b: Good moments, like the throne room fight.

dimensions.name: Effects
dimensions.a: Heavy CGI that has aged unevenly.
dimensions.b: A smart mix of practical and digital effects.

dimensions.name: Legacy
dimensions.a: Reappraised by a generation who grew up with them; meme gold.
dimensions.b: Still divisive years later.

pros_a: Revenge of the Sith is a strong finish
pros_b: The Force Awakens recaptured the old magic

question: Is Elden Ring better than Dark Souls?
summary: Elden Ring wins: Dark Souls has the tighter interconnected world, but Elden Ring took FromSoftware's formula and made it bigger, freer and more accessible.
winner_reason: Elden Ring's open world lets you explore around a hard boss instead of hitting a wall, and it won Game of the Year at The Game Awards 2022. Dark Souls invented the modern template, but Elden Ring is the more complete experience.

dimensions.name: World design
dimensions.a: A brilliant, interconnected world full of shortcuts.
dimensions.b: A vast open world with surprising secrets.

dimensions.name: Freedom
dimensions.a: Linear in places; you must beat certain bosses.
dimensions.b: Go anywhere and come back stronger.

dimensions.name: Bosses
dimensions.a: Ornstein and Smough and Artorias are classics.
dimensions.b: A huge roster, with some all-timers like Malenia.

dimensions.name: Influence
dimensions.a: Created the soulslike genre.
dimensions.b: Brought it to a massive new audience.

dimensions.name: Accessibility
dimensions.a: Brutal for newcomers.
dimensions.b: Spirit summons and exploration ease the difficulty.

pros_b: Huge variety of builds and bosses

question: Who is better, Oasis or Blur?
summary: Oasis wins: Blur won the 1995 singles race and had more range, but Oasis wrote the bigger anthems and won the war.
winner_reason: Country House beat Roll With It in the famous 1995 chart battle, but (What's the Story) Morning Glory went on to become one of the best-selling British albums ever. Songs like Wonderwall and Don't Look Back in Anger are sung by stadiums, and their 2025 reunion tour proved the pull is still there.

dimensions.name: Anthems
dimensions.a: Song 2 and Parklife are huge.
dimensions.b: Wonderwall, Live Forever and Don't Look Back in Anger.

dimensions.name: Range
dimensions.a: Moved from Britpop to lo-fi to art-rock.
dimensions.b: Mostly big guitar rock.

dimensions.name: Albums
dimensions.a: Parklife and 13 hold up brilliantly.
dimensions.b: Definitely Maybe and Morning Glory are classics.

dimensions.name: Commercial
dimensions.a: Big UK success, more modest abroad.
dimensions.b: Bigger sales and global reach.

dimensions.name: Battle of Britpop
dimensions.a: Won the 1995 single showdown.
dimensions.b: Lost that week, won the decade.

pros_a: Damon Albarn's later work is brilliant

question: Which is the better Christmas movie, Elf or Home Alone?
summary: Home Alone wins: Elf is a joy, but Home Alone's booby traps, John Williams score and family heart make it the Christmas classic.
winner_reason: Home Alone has been a family Christmas tradition since 1990, combining slapstick, real warmth and a fantastic score. Elf is wonderfully sweet and Will Ferrell is perfect, but Home Alone is the one more families come back to every year.

dimensions.name: Comedy
dimensions.a: Will Ferrell's wide-eyed Buddy is endlessly funny.
dimensions.b: Slapstick traps and Kevin's antics.

dimensions.name: Christmas spirit
dimensions.a: All about believing in Christmas.
dimensions.b: Family, forgiveness and the old man next door.

dimensions.name: Music
dimensions.a: Baby It's Cold Outside and a fun soundtrack.
dimensions.b: A classic John Williams score.

dimensions.name: Rewatchability
dimensions.a: A modern favourite.
dimensions.b: A holiday staple for decades.

dimensions.name: Iconic scenes
dimensions.a: Syrup on spaghetti and the mail room.
dimensions.b: The aftershave scream and the trap finale.
